page.overview:
Who is Farrus Belisk?

Doctor Farrus Belisk was a male Human scientist Belisk raised concerns about Imperial mining operations on the planet Ilum, which were leaking chemical runoff into the native Tauntaun habitat. During the Third Galactic War around 3623 BBY, Belisk was sent to Ilum as part of a survey team to investigate the wreckage of Darth Malgus's space station. Belisk was killed during the mission and his body was later reanimated as a cyberneurotic zombie by the Rakatan mind trap containing the spirit of Darth Nul. The Alliance Commander and Lana Beniko killed his reanimated corpse.

Dr. Farrus Belisk first appeared in the dynamic encounter mission "Troubled Tauns," introduced in Game Update 7.7: Dynamic Worlds, released on May 28, 2025, as part of Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith, the eighth digital expansion to the massively multiplayer online role-playing game Star Wars: The Old Republic.
